title: Two agents independently implement the same retry policy
description: Semantically equivalent tasks use different wording but target the same component and behavior.

agents.label: agent-a
agents.intent: Implement exponential backoff with jitter in ApiClient

agents.label: agent-b
agents.intent: Add jittered retry and exponential delay to outbound API requests

ground_truth.rationale: Both tasks implement the same retry behavior in the same component.

success_criteria: A duplicate-work warning appears before both agents publish ChangeSets.
The agents can record which task will own the shared retry policy.
The non-owning task can be re-scoped or discarded without losing provenance.
